questions.stem: Which feature of palisade mesophyll cells makes them well-suited for photosynthesis?

options.text: They are packed tightly with many chloroplasts and are found near the upper surface of the leaf
They have no cell wall, allowing more light to enter
They contain haemoglobin to transport gases efficiently
They have a long axon to transmit signals about light levels

questions.explanation: Palisade mesophyll cells are packed with chloroplasts and positioned near the top of the leaf where they receive the most light, maximising the rate of photosynthesis.
